textfsm.name: Interface status

Gi0/1 up
Gi0/2 down
Gi0/3 up
textfsm.template:
Value INTERFACE (\S+)
Value STATUS (up|down)

Start
  ^${INTERFACE}\s+${STATUS} -> Record

textfsm.name: Routing table
textfsm.template:
Value PREFIX (\S+)
Value NEXT_HOP (\S+)
Value INTERFACE (\S+)

Start
  ^${PREFIX}\s+${NEXT_HOP}\s+${INTERFACE} -> Record

textfsm.name: BGP neighbor summary
textfsm.template:
Value NEIGHBOR (\S+)
Value ASN (\d+)
Value STATE (\S+)
Value PREFIXES (\d+)

Start
  ^${NEIGHBOR}\s+${ASN}\s+${STATE}\s+${PREFIXES} -> Record
